question.:question/problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-2x-2y-4z&=-4 \\ -x-4z&=6 \\ -2x-y-7z&=6\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & -2 & -4 & -4 \\ -1 & 0 & -4 & 6 \\ -2 & -1 & -7 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=-\frac{1}{2}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & 2 \\ -1 & 0 & -4 & 6 \\ -2 & -1 & -7 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 8 \\ -2 & -1 & -7 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 10\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-1R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -2\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y+2z&=2 \\ y-2z&=8 \\ z&=-2\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=-2 \\ y&=8-(-2)(-2)=4 \\ x&=2-(1)(4)-(2)(-2)=2.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle 2,4,-2\rangle$.

Consider the system of linear equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-2y-z&=-2 \\ -2x+5y+z&=-3 \\ -2x+6y+2z&=-2\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ -2 & 5 & 1 & -3 \\ -2 & 6 & 2 & -2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -7 \\ -2 & 6 & 2 & -2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -7 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & -6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -7 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -7 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-2y-z&=-2 \\ y-z&=-7 \\ z&=4\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=4 \\ y&=-7-(-1)(4)=-3 \\ x&=-2-(-2)(-3)-(-1)(4)=-4.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle -4,-3,4\rangle$.

$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}2 & -4 & -2 & -4 \\ 2 & -3 & -1 & -2 \\ 2 & -2 & 2 & -8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_1:=\frac{1}{2}R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ 2 & -3 & -1 & -2 \\ 2 & -2 & 2 & -8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2-2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 2 & -2 & 2 & -8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 & -4\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_2$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & -8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -4\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

The corresponding triangular system is

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-2y-z&=-2 \\ y+z&=2 \\ z&=-4\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Back substitution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}z&=-4 \\ y&=2-(1)(-4)=6 \\ x&=-2-(-2)(6)-(-1)(-4)=6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $\langle 6,6,-4\rangle$.

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 4 \\ -1 & -1 & -4 & -2\end{array}\right].

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -1\end{array}\right].
